title: Understanding L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization, also known as Ridge Regression, adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This helps in reducing overfitting by discouraging overly complex models.

title: Effect on Training Set
text: When L2 regularization is applied, the model complexity is reduced. This can lead to a decrease in variance but might increase bias. Consider how this affects the model's performance on the training set.

title: Impact on Model Bias
text: Does adding L2 regularization increase or decrease the bias of the model on the training set?

title: Impact on Model Variance
text: Does adding L2 regularization increase or decrease the variance of the model on the training set?

title: Trade-off Between Bias and Variance
text: L2 regularization introduces a trade-off between bias and variance. While it may increase bias, it generally decreases variance, leading to a more generalized model.
